pages.title: Drumhearts
pages.text:
The Drumhearts kept the beat under the whole sky. Spirit Pulse — power as rhythm before it was a number — ran from their drums along the lattice to every tribe.

The orphan engines you find still keep their time. Listen before you feed one.

pages.title: Spark Strand
pages.text:
*The drum is not loud. The drum is steady. Be the drum.*

Seated. The Drumhearts answer when this Post hums.

pages.title: Their camp
pages.text:
The Drumhearts keep a camp in the March steppe: huts, a fire, a Tribe Hearth, a Fire totem, a banner and four Kin — an Elder, a Drummer, a Hunter and a Weaver.

Their hearth favours copper, charged Pulse Cells, Bone Chimes. Their Elder trades Bone Chimes and Pulse Cells, and at Voice standing presses the tribe's Mark into your hand.
